Marks a noindex page and still follows its links when robots directives are respected

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"max_depth":1,"respect_robots_txt":true}');
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine(config: engineConfig);
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.crawl(engine, url);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages.length);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[0].noindexDetected);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[0].nofollowDetected);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[1].noindexDetected);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[1].nofollowDetected);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
